Auth

Add a workspace to give a team member their own access token.

Paste the host URL and a personal access token for this team member. GitHub.com is https://github.com. A Forgejo instance is the origin you sign in at. The token needs access to repositories and pull requests, so Agent-Up can list every repository this member can see.
